main_text.p: XIX. Dico tertiò, dato adhuc ulterius, nec concesso tamen, licentiam aliquam ipsis subditis eo Aphorismo concedi, ut posthabitis Legibus, ita postulante necessitate, saluti publicæ consulant: non tamen inde effici, quod nonnulli voluerunt. Non quasi subditis liceret, ubi libertatem suam in aliquâ re læsam aut sentiunt, aut sentire se vocife-rantur, mox omnia Legum & officii repagula disji-cere, & inconsulto Principe arma rapere, tumul-tibúsque & seditionibus omnia complere. Sed quod pro salute Principis & suâ adversus externos hostes, aut perduelles domesticos tuendâ, (ubi tam gravis premit necessitas, ut vir pius & prudens non possit dubitare Legislatorem ipsum, si præsens esset, Legis sibi gratiam & relaxationem concessurum) liceat subditis, communis utilitatis, quæ Suprema Lex est, & omnium Legum Finis, rationem habere magis, quàm Legum particularium, quæ propterea latæ sunt, ut communi utilitati inserviant, non præjudicent.

XX. Summa est, Salutem Reipublicæ, hoc est, Principis & subditorum, Supremam esse Legem, cui inferiores Leges omnes ita infervire debent; ut postulante præsenti necessitate, Principi fas sit, ex potestatis suæ præ-rogativa, imò & subditis fas sit, ex rationabiliter præsumpto Principis consensu, à verbis Legum particularium quandoque recedere, ut periclitanti patriæ subveniant, ejusque Saluti, velut Supremæ Legi, consulant. Ita tamen, ut sub prætextu Publicæ Salutis libertatisve nisi ex voluntate & consensu Supremæ Potestatis, vel expresso, vel (ut dixi) rationabiliter præsumpto, non fit aliquid, quod leges non permittunt, attentandum.
XXI. Restant adhuc Dubia non pauca, ad causam hanc Finalem quoquo modo pertinentia; ut de Privilegiis, de Dispensationibus, de Relaxa-

page.notes: The first word "XIX." and the other numbered openings are printed in a larger, bolder face but are part of the paragraph, so they are not headings. The printed text has no headings on this page. "posthabitis" is printed with a long s and the word is read as "posthabitis". The last line of the text is a line that breaks at "Relaxa-"; the catchword "tionem" is partly legible at the foot (the abbreviation mark is uncertain) and is given with its likely form. Italic words were read from the scan and may be slightly uncertain. The left strip is the edge of the neighbouring printed page and is omitted.
